==Goal==

Race around the circuit and be the first driver to complete '''3 laps''' (or the agreed number of laps) by crossing the finish line!

==Setup==

* Players start in the pit lane based on a qualifying roll.
* Each player begins with a car, '''6 dice''', and '''3 lap discs''' in their pit box.

==Your Turn==

If your car is currently '''belly-up (crashed)''', your turn is spent righting it: flip your car upright and pass your turn. It does not move.

Otherwise, you may choose to '''Fix''' or '''Roll''':

===Fixing Your Car===
Instead of moving, you may retrieve one die from your pit box back into your pool. Your car remains stationary this turn.

===Rolling the Dice===
Roll your dice one at a time, up to the number of dice you currently have:
* After each roll, you may choose to '''stop''' or '''roll another die'''.
* '''Success (no duplicate numbers):''' Sum all rolled dice values and move your car forward exactly that many spaces along the track.
* '''Duplicate number on a straight track:''' Your turn ends immediately and your car does not move.
* '''Duplicate number on a corner:''' Your car '''crashes'''! Flip your car belly-up, lose one die to your pit box, and end your turn.

==Bumping and Collisions==

* When your car ends its movement on a space occupied by another car on a straight section, you '''bump''' that car forward 1 space. Cascading bumps occur if multiple cars are adjacent.
* If a car is bumped into a corner, it crashes!
* Cars already sitting on corners cannot be pushed forward; if another car enters or bumps that corner, a collision occurs and cars crash.

==Special Features & Items==

* '''Shortcut:''' Once per race, you may steer through the shortcut to save distance. Using the shortcut expends your shortcut cylinder.
* '''Turbine:''' Extra speed boost forward.
* '''Rocket:''' Target and disrupt vehicles ahead of you.
* '''Bomb & Oil Spill:''' Drop hazards behind you on the track.
* '''Wrench:''' Instantly repair and recover a lost die.

==Winning the Race==

Each time you cross the finish line after completing a circuit, remove one lap disc from your box. The first player to remove all 3 discs wins the Grand Prix! Remaining players continue racing to determine podium positions.
